rows.text: You're walking down a deserted country road with a bag full of Sealing Wax. Suddenly, a huge purple spherical object, which looks just like a grape, jumps out...
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "This mountain's mine to claim, and this path's mine to... wait, that's not right..." says the purple grape. Apparently it is a living thing.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "I am the Amphorean God of Sealing Wax." It puts its hands on its hips and puffs out its chest. "Give me your Sealing Wax, and I'll synthesize a super powerful one for you!"
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
